prompt:
Edit the first attached project-owned candidate sprite. The remaining four project images are grass.png, forest_floor.png, packed_earth_road.png, wheat_farm_ripe-v4.png and are palette/style references. This is a TARGETED READABILITY REVISION, not a new scene.
Keep a true transparent background and the same medieval English low vegetation edge subject. Keep variant A main foliage on the LEFT. Exact delivery target is 128×96 pixels, with 8px fully empty alpha margin all around and bottom-center ground anchor. The current candidate disappears at 38×29px runtime. REDRAW into much larger, simpler, chunkier forms: only TWO broad grass tufts and ONE small squat fern, fewer broad leaf lobes, strongly simplified coherent silhouette. Reduce the leaf-litter ground plate to a thin narrow broken line. The occupied artwork should be about112px WIDE and72–76px TALL at target resolution, not a wide flat smear; plant mass should occupy most of that height. Raise the foliage midtones about15 percent relative to the dark leaf litter, still muted olive matching the existing grass. Modest tight contact darks at roots only, NO cast shadow. Some negative-space gap between tufts, do not turn into a full hedge.
Draw as a consciously low-resolution game icon: broad opaque leaf masses with 2–3 tonal planes, no vein detail, no speckle, no fine leaf confetti, no tiny repeated blades. 2:1 orthographic isometric ground perspective. Do NOT add tree trunks, flowers, stones, buildings, text, tile base or blur. Preserve left/right alpha taper. Distinct A/B silhouette, not mirror clones. Make the final 64×48 and38×29 presentation readable without sharpening filters.
